WITH trader_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    t.tradekind AS trader_type,
    COUNT(tr.transreg) AS count_records
  FROM transactionrecord tr
  INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
summary AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(count_records) AS total_count,
    AVG(count_records) AS avg_count
  FROM trader_counts
)
SELECT 
  tc.trader_type,
  tc.count_records,
  CAST(tc.count_records AS REAL) / s.total_count AS proportion,
  tc.count_records - s.avg_count AS above_average
FROM trader_counts tc
CROSS JOIN summary s
WHERE s.avg_count IS NOT NULL
  AND tc.count_records > s.avg_count;
